420	### Shared Installed Release Basis And Toolchain Manager
421	
422	Within the product-definition-routing bounded context, an **Installed Release
423	Basis** is the pair:
424	
425	```text
426	(immutable stdo://releases/<cut>/ URI, installed-manifest SHA-256)
427	```
428	
429	The URI identifies one immutable annotated RC cut. The digest identifies the
430	deterministic installed-release manifest that binds its tag object, commit,
431	repository tree, standards subtree, exact standards inventory, member bytes,
432	and admitted auxiliary payloads. The manifest shape is owned by
433	`schemas/installed-release-manifest.schema.json`. It is transport and integrity
434	evidence, not a replacement constitution.
435	
436	An **Adoption Plan** is the read-only, deterministic acceptance object binding
437	one current Product Definition's identity and bytes to its current basis and
438	one resolved immutable target's cut, annotated tag object, commit, tree, and
439	installed-manifest digest. Its SHA-256 is the operator-presentable acceptance
440	token; possession alone does not grant authority, while a mismatch proves that
441	the presented subject is no longer the subject being mutated. A **Fleet
442	Adoption Plan** binds an authorized fleet root and the complete ordered set of
443	per-definition plan digests under the same law.
444	
445	Plan hashing uses the acceptance object only: local installation status and
446	machine-local install paths are excluded. Its canonical bytes are UTF-8 JSON
447	with recursively sorted object keys, two-space indentation, LF line endings,
448	and one final LF. Fleet order is deterministic discovery-path order. These
449	rules make a presented digest independently reproducible rather than an opaque
450	session token.
451	
452	The **STDO Toolchain Manager** is the bounded executable realization that:
453	
454	- installs each immutable cut once in a shared, versioned release store;
455	- resolves logical `stdo://releases/...` URIs to verified installed bytes;
456	- inventories and verifies complete installed distributions;
457	- synchronizes the exact basis already selected by a Product Definition;
458	- emits an exact digest-bound adoption plan from a mutable version-line
459	  selector and performs adoption only when that plan is explicitly accepted;
460	- manages the stable marker-bounded bootstrap in declared agent files; and
461	- applies those operations to an explicitly discovered fleet of Product
462	  Definitions.
463	
464	The store may live at any machine-local path. Its registry maps logical release
465	URIs to installed paths and manifest digests, but owns neither Product
466	selection nor method meaning. A consumer repository therefore does not need a
467	project-local standards copy or a prescribed folder structure. Several Product
468	Definitions on one machine may select different installed cuts concurrently.
469	Every manager-owned component from the configured store root downward must be
470	a physical directory or regular file of its declared type. A symlink, junction,
471	reparse point, device, socket, or other redirection or special entry fails
472	closed. Verification inventories every filesystem entry type, including
473	directories, and rejects any entry not derived from the manifest's exact file
474	paths. It never follows an unmanifested alias.
475	
476	`constitution.stdo.source.repository` identifies the transport source.
477	`constitution.stdo.selector` is a mutable `stdo://channels/<version>` discovery
478	selector whose Git alias semantics are owned by `RELEASE_METHOD.md`. Neither is
479	operative authority. `constitution.stdo.basis.uri` and
480	`constitution.stdo.basis.manifest_sha256` are the sole authored STDO selection
481	for that Product Definition.
482	
483	The manager observes these command boundaries:
484	
485	- `install` admits one explicitly named immutable RC cut without changing any
486	  Product Definition;
487	- `sync` installs and verifies only the exact basis already selected by the
488	  Product Definition and never consults its mutable selector;
489	- `adopt --dry-run` resolves the annotated selector and immutable RC, presents
490	  the target cut, tag object, commit, tree, manifest digest, current Product-
491	  Definition byte digest, and a deterministic adoption-plan digest without
492	  mutation;
493	- mutating `adopt` requires that exact prior plan digest as explicit
494	  acceptance, re-derives it before installation, installs only the bound target,
495	  rechecks the Product Definition bytes, and atomically changes only its basis
496	  and basis-relative schema locator; any drift refuses mutation;
497	- `status`, `verify`, `list`, `manifest`, and `resolve` are read-only with
498	  respect to Product Definitions; and
499	- fleet adoption emits and requires explicit acceptance of one aggregate plan
500	  digest over every per-definition plan; all fleet writes require explicit
501	  whole-selection authorization and do not infer composition or inheritance
502	  from directory nesting.
503	
504	Missing cuts, moved immutable tags, tag-to-commit mismatch, manifest-digest
505	mismatch, missing, extra, or changed installed members, ambiguous Product
506	Definition discovery, unaccepted or stale adoption plans, URI escape, physical
507	store redirection, undeclared filesystem entry types, and malformed bootstrap
508	markers fail closed. Every `stdo:` schema locator is parsed before schema
509	loading under URI scheme case-insensitivity and must name the same immutable
510	cut as `constitution.stdo.basis`; spelling variation cannot cross that basis.
511	No cache, registry entry, source checkout, version alias, schema, or agent file
512	may silently replace the basis selected in the Product Definition.
513	
514	`constitution.agent_bootstrap` does not embed another constitution. It names
515	one basis-qualified bootstrap entrypoint and the local instruction files whose
516	small discovery block the manager owns between explicit markers. Each target
517	is a portable relative path resolved against `product.source_project`; absolute
518	paths, parent traversal, redirected path components, and escape from that
519	boundary fail closed. A fleet additionally confines every resolved source
520	project to its explicitly authorized fleet root and preflights every target
521	before the first write. Exactly one correctly ordered marker span may be
522	replaced. Bytes before and after it, including trailing whitespace, remain
523	project-owned and byte-identical; appending a new span preserves all existing
524	bytes as an exact prefix. The bootstrap routes agents to the applicable Product
525	Definition, exact installed basis, and owning sources; it cannot restate or
526	override them.
527	
528	Recursive fleet discovery prunes these exact directory names as VCS,
529	dependency, generated, cache, or managed-store internals:
530	`.git`, `.hg`, `.svn`, `.bzr`, `.venv`, `venv`, `node_modules`, `vendor`,
531	`site-packages`, `build`, `dist`, `out`, `target`, `.gradle`, `.tox`, `.nox`,
532	`.cache`, `.ruff_cache`, `.mypy_cache`, `.pytest_cache`, `__pycache__`,
533	`.genesis`, and `.stdo`. Discovered Product Definitions may not themselves be
534	symlinks. These exclusions are discovery law, not evidence that an excluded
535	tree lacks another independently governed Product.
536	
537	#### Explicit Complete Consumer Update
538	
539	A **Complete Consumer Update Plan** binds one explicitly selected Product
540	Definition and the complete companion population of one exact upstream
541	release-matched cohort to the consumer bindings selected by the invocation's
542	owner. The Product Definition continues to own composition; the upstream
543	cohort and each Product's release record own release and member identity.
544	An invocation selection and its derived plan/result are operation evidence,
545	not another persistent dependency declaration, registry or lock. The caller
546	must select every native route and derived context for the claimed update
547	scope; directory proximity or an empty discovery result cannot supply that
548	selection. An empty derived-context population means the owner selected none,
549	not that the manager established the absence of semantic context.
550	
551	The separate `cohort-update` operation presents the whole plan without consumer
552	effects. Unlike the basis-only Adoption Plan above, its acceptance object also
553	binds physical effect destinations and binding preimages, exact selected
554	cohort bytes, companion annotated tags/commits/subtrees and inventories,
555	replacement dependency locators, native routes, and declared derived-source
556	observations. It uses the same canonical JSON hashing rule. Already-installed
557	status supplies no additional authority and does not change the digest.
558	Mutation requires explicit acceptance of this exact plan and rederives it;
559	possession of its digest alone grants no operation authority. Existing
560	`adopt`, `sync` and fleet contracts retain their narrower boundaries.
561	
562	The complete operation verifies the selected cohort's dependency closure and
563	each exact companion's definition, release record and admitted members before
564	reliance. It stages absent immutable installs, verifies existing installs
565	without repairing them in place, and preflights every consumer target. Only
566	the selected basis/schema, existing composition locators/contracts and selected
567	native/install links may change. Historical installs and unrelated consumer
568	content remain available and unchanged. It creates no consumer-local checker
569	and changes no Product meaning or local semantic map.
570	
571	For each selected derived context, missing, ambiguous, changed or unavailable
572	program/map/source evidence holds the complete update before consumer effects.
573	Its source owner must perform any necessary semantic re-entry; the manager
574	cannot mechanically relabel an older map as current. Exact source freshness is
575	integrity evidence, not semantic conformance or an independent semantic verdict.
576	After immutable staging the manager rechecks the consumer preimages and source
577	evidence. It reports completion only after verifying every selected resulting
578	binding and companion. Refusal before consumer effects retains prior state;
579	a caught application failure restores the affected consumer preimages and
580	does not report completion. Newly staged immutable installs may remain unused.
581	The operation requires an exclusive consumer write scope during application.
582	It does not claim a crash-atomic transaction across independent filesystem
583	paths: abrupt process/host loss or unavailable rollback storage requires
584	recovery from the presented preimages before claiming the complete relation.
585	
586	### Bounded-Context Semantic Resolution
587	
588	`SPEC_METHOD.md` owns this law in the semantic-resolution bounded context
589	`urn:stdo:bounded-context:semantic-resolution` under the selected complete STDO

Plan hashing uses the acceptance object only: local installation status and
machine-local install paths are excluded. Its canonical bytes are UTF-8 JSON
with recursively sorted object keys, two-space indentation, LF line endings,
and one final LF. Fleet order is deterministic discovery-path order. These
rules make a presented digest independently reproducible rather than an opaque
session token.

The **STDO Toolchain Manager** is the bounded executable realization that:

- installs each immutable cut once in a shared, versioned release store;
- resolves logical `stdo://releases/...` URIs to verified installed bytes;
- inventories and verifies complete installed distributions;
- synchronizes the exact basis already selected by a Product Definition;
- emits an exact digest-bound adoption plan from a mutable version-line
  selector and performs adoption only when that plan is explicitly accepted;
- manages the stable marker-bounded bootstrap in declared agent files; and
- applies those operations to an explicitly discovered fleet of Product
  Definitions.

The store may live at any machine-local path. Its registry maps logical release
URIs to installed paths and manifest digests, but owns neither Product
selection nor method meaning. A consumer repository therefore does not need a
project-local standards copy or a prescribed folder structure. Several Product
Definitions on one machine may select different installed cuts concurrently.
Every manager-owned component from the configured store root downward must be
a physical directory or regular file of its declared type. A symlink, junction,
reparse point, device, socket, or other redirection or special entry fails
closed. Verification inventories every filesystem entry type, including
directories, and rejects any entry not derived from the manifest's exact file
paths. It never follows an unmanifested alias.

`constitution.stdo.source.repository` identifies the transport source.
`constitution.stdo.selector` is a mutable `stdo://channels/<version>` discovery
selector whose Git alias semantics are owned by `RELEASE_METHOD.md`. Neither is
operative authority. `constitution.stdo.basis.uri` and
`constitution.stdo.basis.manifest_sha256` are the sole authored STDO selection
for that Product Definition.

The manager observes these command boundaries:

- `install` admits one explicitly named immutable RC cut without changing any
  Product Definition;
- `sync` installs and verifies only the exact basis already selected by the
  Product Definition and never consults its mutable selector;
- `adopt --dry-run` resolves the annotated selector and immutable RC, presents
  the target cut, tag object, commit, tree, manifest digest, current Product-
  Definition byte digest, and a deterministic adoption-plan digest without
  mutation;
- mutating `adopt` requires that exact prior plan digest as explicit
  acceptance, re-derives it before installation, installs only the bound target,
  rechecks the Product Definition bytes, and atomically changes only its basis
  and basis-relative schema locator; any drift refuses mutation;
- `status`, `verify`, `list`, `manifest`, and `resolve` are read-only with
  respect to Product Definitions; and
- fleet adoption emits and requires explicit acceptance of one aggregate plan
  digest over every per-definition plan; all fleet writes require explicit
  whole-selection authorization and do not infer composition or inheritance
  from directory nesting.

Missing cuts, moved immutable tags, tag-to-commit mismatch, manifest-digest
mismatch, missing, extra, or changed installed members, ambiguous Product
Definition discovery, unaccepted or stale adoption plans, URI escape, physical
store redirection, undeclared filesystem entry types, and malformed bootstrap
markers fail closed. Every `stdo:` schema locator is parsed before schema
loading under URI scheme case-insensitivity and must name the same immutable
cut as `constitution.stdo.basis`; spelling variation cannot cross that basis.
No cache, registry entry, source checkout, version alias, schema, or agent file
may silently replace the basis selected in the Product Definition.

`constitution.agent_bootstrap` does not embed another constitution. It names
one basis-qualified bootstrap entrypoint and the local instruction files whose
small discovery block the manager owns between explicit markers. Each target
is a portable relative path resolved against `product.source_project`; absolute
paths, parent traversal, redirected path components, and escape from that
boundary fail closed. A fleet additionally confines every resolved source
project to its explicitly authorized fleet root and preflights every target
before the first write. Exactly one correctly ordered marker span may be
replaced. Bytes before and after it, including trailing whitespace, remain
project-owned and byte-identical; appending a new span preserves all existing
bytes as an exact prefix. The bootstrap routes agents to the applicable Product
Definition, exact installed basis, and owning sources; it cannot restate or
override them.

Recursive fleet discovery prunes these exact directory names as VCS,
dependency, generated, cache, or managed-store internals:
`.git`, `.hg`, `.svn`, `.bzr`, `.venv`, `venv`, `node_modules`, `vendor`,
`site-packages`, `build`, `dist`, `out`, `target`, `.gradle`, `.tox`, `.nox`,
`.cache`, `.ruff_cache`, `.mypy_cache`, `.pytest_cache`, `__pycache__`,
`.genesis`, and `.stdo`. Discovered Product Definitions may not themselves be
symlinks. These exclusions are discovery law, not evidence that an excluded
tree lacks another independently governed Product.

#### Explicit Complete Consumer Update

A **Complete Consumer Update Plan** binds one explicitly selected Product
Definition and the complete companion population of one exact upstream
release-matched cohort to the consumer bindings selected by the invocation's
owner. The Product Definition continues to own composition; the upstream
cohort and each Product's release record own release and member identity.
An invocation selection and its derived plan/result are operation evidence,
not another persistent dependency declaration, registry or lock. The caller
must select every native route and derived context for the claimed update
scope; directory proximity or an empty discovery result cannot supply that
selection. An empty derived-context population means the owner selected none,
not that the manager established the absence of semantic context.

The separate `cohort-update` operation presents the whole plan without consumer
effects. Unlike the basis-only Adoption Plan above, its acceptance object also
binds physical effect destinations and binding preimages, exact selected
cohort bytes, companion annotated tags/commits/subtrees and inventories,
replacement dependency locators, native routes, and declared derived-source
observations. It uses the same canonical JSON hashing rule. Already-installed
status supplies no additional authority and does not change the digest.
Mutation requires explicit acceptance of this exact plan and rederives it;
possession of its digest alone grants no operation authority. Existing
`adopt`, `sync` and fleet contracts retain their narrower boundaries.

The complete operation verifies the selected cohort's dependency closure and
each exact companion's definition, release record and admitted members before
reliance. It stages absent immutable installs, verifies existing installs
without repairing them in place, and preflights every consumer target. Only
the selected basis/schema, existing composition locators/contracts and selected
native/install links may change. Historical installs and unrelated consumer
content remain available and unchanged. It creates no consumer-local checker
and changes no Product meaning or local semantic map.

For each selected derived context, missing, ambiguous, changed or unavailable
program/map/source evidence holds the complete update before consumer effects.
Its source owner must perform any necessary semantic re-entry; the manager
cannot mechanically relabel an older map as current. Exact source freshness is
integrity evidence, not semantic conformance or an independent semantic verdict.
After immutable staging the manager rechecks the consumer preimages and source
evidence. It reports completion only after verifying every selected resulting
binding and companion. Refusal before consumer effects retains prior state;
a caught application failure restores the affected consumer preimages and
does not report completion. Newly staged immutable installs may remain unused.
The operation requires an exclusive consumer write scope during application.
It does not claim a crash-atomic transaction across independent filesystem
paths: abrupt process/host loss or unavailable rollback storage requires
recovery from the presented preimages before claiming the complete relation.

### Bounded-Context Semantic Resolution

`SPEC_METHOD.md` owns this law in the semantic-resolution bounded context
`urn:stdo:bounded-context:semantic-resolution` under the selected complete STDO

## Change Management Rule

Every substantive change begins with intake triage, an explicit declared change
intent, and a lawful re-entry point into the constitutional chain.

### Universal Intake Triage

There is one front door for substantive change.

The intake label does not determine the process class.

That means a reported:

- bug
- feature request
- issue
- regression
- operator finding
- release blocker
- scenario failure

all enter through the same intake-triage process.

Intake triage must determine:

- whether the report represents a substantive change at all
- the affected product boundary and intended scope
- the lawful change class
- the lawful re-entry point into the constitutional chain
- the downstream surfaces and evidence that must be repriced, re-derived, or
  re-proved
- whether the work remains within the currently declared release scope or
  requires repricing of that release plan

No bug, feature, issue, or other intake may bypass this triage by going
straight to code, tests, or release handling.

The purpose of triage is not to create a separate tracking bureaucracy. It is
to classify impact correctly so the change enters the method at the right
constitutional boundary.

The minimum lawful change classes are:

- `goal_reprice`: current bounded work-wave focus changes; re-enters at Goals and may flow through Intent, Product, Requirements, Design, Code, and Evidence where that focus changes deeper constitutional truth
- `intent_reprice`: directional or scope change; re-enters at Intent and flows through Product, Requirements, Design, Code, and Evidence
- `product_reprice`: current product realization changes while directional intent remains stable; re-enters at Product and flows through Requirements, Design, Code, and Evidence
- `requirement_reprice`: constitutional truth changes while project direction remains stable; re-enters at Requirements and flows through Design, Code, and Evidence
- `design_reframe`: realization structure changes while active intent and requirement truth remain stable; re-enters at Design and flows through Code and Evidence
- `realization_refactor`: local code, configuration, or attribute change with no intended constitutional or structural change; re-enters at the realized surface only and must prove no upstream drift

Smaller changes may re-enter below Goals only if they explicitly assert that no
upstream constitutional surface is changing.

The absence of a declared change class is process drift.

### Computed Classification And Treatment

Intake supplies one reusable classification result rather than requiring each
role to reconstruct the same facts. `C` denotes reproducible facts and declared
rule application; `J` denotes residual semantic or materiality judgment; `O`
denotes a ruling reserved to its actual owner. These annotations grant no
authority and introduce no calculus kind, runtime, classifier interface, or
mandatory document.

The explicitly selected source, worksite, or qualification capability produces
C over the exact request and desired outcome, known targets and effects,
operation grant and work lifetime, Product Definition and governing basis,
baseline and available candidate, declared relations, accepted design and
trace bindings, evidence, and applicable rules. Its output identifies the
producer and procedure revision, inputs, result, scope, source routes,
reproduction relation, unknowns and invalidators. Missing candidate or evidence
is an input state, not a claim that nothing changed.

The computed result must expose:

1. **Authority traversal.** Follow explicit source, ownership, dependency,
   composition and projection declarations from the affected targets and
   effects. Identify each reached layer and owner, its exact basis and
   changed/unchanged/unknown relation, the traversed edges, and the unresolved
   frontier. Include root, authority and grant changes even when Public bytes
   are equal. An absent edge does not prove irrelevance; undeclared or
   semantically uncertain materiality remains J.
2. **Public delta.** Enumerate the complete relevant serialized member universe
   under its owning declaration and applicable projection, including helper and
   generated dependencies. Report added and removed identities and every
   retained member with changed typed value or bytes, with exact before/after
   values. A rename is removal plus addition unless its owner supplies an
   identity-preserving relation. Missing candidate, incomplete enumeration,
   ambiguous identity or unavailable projection leaves the affected delta
   unknown; membership equality alone proves no value equality.
3. **Accepted-design coverage.** Join changed bytes and relations to explicit
   accepted scope, traces and acceptance evidence. Distinguish covered,
   missing, stale, ambiguous and outside-scope evidence. A filename, listed
   artifact or digest alone establishes no accepted coverage. Current trace
   coverage is a computed fact; residual semantic sufficiency remains J.
4. **Rule-determined treatment.** Apply only declared rules with sufficient
   input facts, recording their owners, matched predicates and consequences.
   Expose the smallest lawful re-entry, next action, applicable evidence or
   assessment, reserved ruling and carrier lifetime, with any conflict or
   missing premise still unresolved. A label or filename cannot select the
   route. When rules settle the question, invent no residual judgment.

A Public delta or other nonconformance does not itself require changing the
governing contract. If that contract remains sufficient for the authorized
outcome, reject or locally repair the candidate within its grant. Re-enter
the actual governing owner when the explicitly selected desired outcome
requires changed meaning or an applicable assessment establishes governing
insufficiency. C determines that consequence only from sufficient declared
premises; unresolved intended meaning or necessity is J and any reserved
decision remains O. Candidate behavior cannot author its own target law.

Unknown treatment withholds dependent reliance or promotion, not unrelated
authorized work. An existing bounded construction or evidence grant may permit
the cheapest useful discriminator, including obtaining the first candidate,
without asserting that the candidate is conformant. It carries its own exact subject,
territory, operations and stop conditions. Update the affected C result before
dependent effects or promotion rely on newly available evidence. Correct a
mistaken route at its smallest affected owner; preserve the original cause,
attempted subject, observed effect state and valid progress. Retry requires
the applicable outcome, authority and safe-recovery conditions; an unknown
effect state cannot be silently treated as no effect.

A new role, conversation or resumption reuses valid C after checking exact
applicability. Changed request, candidate, basis, owner/root relation,
projection, design trace/acceptance, rule, configuration or material evidence
invalidates its affected claims before reliance. Preserve predecessor and
successor identities, changed inputs, surviving facts and affected J
dependencies; recompute the wider frontier where independence is unproved.
`TICKET_METHOD.md` owns the existing carrier and recorded-J/O continuity rules.

---

## Consistency Gate Rule

No gate may close while the affected active surfaces are internally inconsistent.

1470	## Agentic Construction Execution (`STDO-UP-020`)
1471	
1472	When construction is delegated to a probabilistic or agentic worker, the
1473	method governs the execution relation without prescribing the worker's model,
1474	prompt, tools, internal search, process topology, repository layout, or
1475	orchestration runtime.
1476	
1477	The normative relation is:
1478	
1479	```text
1480	accepted governing basis
1481	  -> bounded affected relation set
1482	  -> selected computational relations
1483	  -> delegated execution and decision authority
1484	  -> construction and self-review
1485	  -> independent live-surface assessment where required
1486	  -> accept | local repair | re-enter | reject
1487	  -> exact accepted checkpoint
1488	  -> next already-authorized bounded action
1489	```
1490	
1491	### Sufficient Execution Intake
1492	
1493	A bounded action begins from an authority basis sufficient to reconstruct its
1494	governing relations without conversation history, commentary, prior-worker
1495	memory, or implementation folklore. The intake identifies:
1496	
1497	- the selected Product outcome, prerequisite, or admitted experiment;
1498	- the bounded affected relation set and applicable governing invariants;
1499	- accepted transformation-admission relations;
1500	- selected computational or common-library dispositions;
1501	- construction and assessment authority; and
1502	- the conditions that require upstream re-entry.
1503	
1504	Where `DESIGN_MODULE_METHOD.md` applies, `STDO-UP-017` bounded-frame
1505	conservation, `STDO-UP-016` transformation-admission completeness,
1506	`STDO-UP-018` invariant-reconstruction sufficiency, and `STDO-UP-019`
1507	computational-realization projection supply these design inputs. This section
1508	consumes those laws; it does not create a second design package.
1509	
1510	### Bounded Causal Construction
1511	
1512	The execution unit is the smallest coherent causal dependency cone capable of
1513	delivering working behavior while preserving every affected governing
1514	relation. It need not coincide with one function, file, module, ticket field,
1515	or design document.
1516	
1517	A seam whose far side can causally affect, or be affected by, the action is
1518	inside the cone unless the basis establishes that it cannot participate.
1519	Unrelated incompleteness outside the cone is recorded as repricing input and
1520	does not block the bounded claim.
1521	
1522	### Construction, Assessment, And Delegation
1523	
1524	The constructor owns bounded implementation and self-review. Where independent
1525	assessment supports promotion, the assessor evaluates the exact live code,
1526	authority paths, proof, and installed subject rather than treating the
1527	constructor's summary as sufficient evidence. This preserves the independent-
1528	review relation; it does not prescribe an actor count. One actor may occupy
1529	different roles across different claims when independence for the assessed
1530	claim is preserved.
1531	
1532	The governing authority relation declares whether a bounded proxy may accept
1533	and advance routine actions. A proxy may accept preservation, require local
1534	repair, reject a violating candidate, and advance to the next already-
1535	authorized action. It cannot change Product meaning, requirements, governing
1536	authority, or accepted design. Such a change re-enters at its owning relation.
1537	
1538	Human ceremony is not required at every transition when the governing basis,
1539	affected cone, decision envelope, and re-entry conditions are already
1540	accepted. This delegation does not weaken direct-human acceptance where
1541	Product or release law requires it.
1542	
1543	When one capable context has sufficient existing work authority, exact intake
1544	and operation grant, it may enter directly as constructor or Writer. No
1545	Executive activation is required solely to appoint that Writer. The applicable
1546	frame configuration selects coordination when material contexts, authority,
1547	capability or required independence need it; a role or frame name alone does
1548	not create that need. Direct entry preserves execution-contract admission,
1549	the smallest lawful carrier, required assessment and reserved decisions. It
1550	permits bounded work and condition-based result recording, not self-acceptance
1551	at a boundary owned elsewhere.
1552	
1553	### Proportional Disposition
1554	
1555	Assessment returns one of these semantic dispositions:
1556	
1557	| Disposition | Condition |
1558	|---|---|
1559	| `accept` | the candidate closes its declared cone and preserves every affected governing relation |
1560	| `local_repair` | implementation or proof is locally defective while the governing relation remains coherent |
1561	| `re_enter` | Product, requirement, identity, lifecycle, authority, public contract, or accepted design must change |
1562	| `reject` | the candidate violates a governing relation or leaves an undisposed competing truth path |
1563	
1564	Global correctness means conserving every global relation affected by the
1565	bounded action. It does not require proving the whole Product inside every
1566	local action.
1567	
1568	Repeated rejection against one unchanged boundary requires reassessment of the
1569	frame altitude, causal cone, common components, design-versus-code placement,
1570	and authority sufficiency. The method sets no rejection-count threshold,
1571	mandatory review-round count, or review state machine; it prohibits repeating
1572	an unchanged failed construction relation as if iteration alone could close it.
1573	
1574	### Transition Evidence And Proof Cadence
1575	
1576	A reviewable transition identifies the exact candidate, affected relations,
1577	changed realization paths, authority paths added or removed, retained and open
1578	seams, focused proof, any required integration proof, explicit non-changes, and
1579	the assessor disposition. Consumers choose the representation. Transition
1580	evidence is a read model and does not become specification, design, or
1581	admission authority.
1582	
1583	Construction uses the cheapest focused proof capable of falsifying the active
1584	relation. Expensive whole-candidate qualification occurs at a declared
1585	candidate boundary rather than after every local edit, unless the affected
1586	risk makes whole-candidate proof necessary.
1587	
1588	A durable or reconstructable authority claim is not established solely by a
1589	same-process proof when loss of incidental process state is a material
1590	counterexample. Proof must destroy or exclude the incidental authority and
1591	compare reconstructed semantic outcomes.
1592	
1593	### Checkpoint, Continuation, Progress, And Churn
1594	
1595	Acceptance binds one exact checkpoint. The next already-authorized bounded
1596	action may begin without renewed human approval; acceptance does not widen the
1597	Product outcome or affected relation set.
1598	
1599	Accepted material Product movement is progress. Prerequisite work names the
1600	Product obligation it enables. Preservation and repeated proof are evidence,
1601	not new progress. Rejected or superseded construction is churn. Discovery of
1602	previously hidden distance revises the forecast but is not itself negative
1603	implementation progress. Paperwork, code volume, test count, commit count, and
1604	review count are not Product progress by themselves.
1605	
1606	These are semantic categories, not a numeric progress algorithm. Consumers may
1607	derive their own progress and churn projections from them.
1608	
1609	This protocol is false if execution proceeds from unreconstructable context,
1610	if a constructor's report substitutes for required independent live evidence,
1611	if a bounded proxy changes a governing relation outside its delegation, if
1612	unrelated incompleteness blocks a closed causal cone, if a same-process test is
1613	used to prove materially cross-process authority, or if rejected activity is
1614	reported as accepted Product progress.
1615	
1616	---
1617	
1618	## Complete Enclosing-Relation Admission (`STDO-UP-021`)

- accepted transformation-admission relations;
- selected computational or common-library dispositions;
- construction and assessment authority; and
- the conditions that require upstream re-entry.

Where `DESIGN_MODULE_METHOD.md` applies, `STDO-UP-017` bounded-frame
conservation, `STDO-UP-016` transformation-admission completeness,
`STDO-UP-018` invariant-reconstruction sufficiency, and `STDO-UP-019`
computational-realization projection supply these design inputs. This section
consumes those laws; it does not create a second design package.

### Bounded Causal Construction

The execution unit is the smallest coherent causal dependency cone capable of
delivering working behavior while preserving every affected governing
relation. It need not coincide with one function, file, module, ticket field,
or design document.

A seam whose far side can causally affect, or be affected by, the action is
inside the cone unless the basis establishes that it cannot participate.
Unrelated incompleteness outside the cone is recorded as repricing input and
does not block the bounded claim.

### Construction, Assessment, And Delegation

The constructor owns bounded implementation and self-review. Where independent
assessment supports promotion, the assessor evaluates the exact live code,
authority paths, proof, and installed subject rather than treating the
constructor's summary as sufficient evidence. This preserves the independent-
review relation; it does not prescribe an actor count. One actor may occupy
different roles across different claims when independence for the assessed
claim is preserved.

The governing authority relation declares whether a bounded proxy may accept
and advance routine actions. A proxy may accept preservation, require local
repair, reject a violating candidate, and advance to the next already-
authorized action. It cannot change Product meaning, requirements, governing
authority, or accepted design. Such a change re-enters at its owning relation.

Human ceremony is not required at every transition when the governing basis,
affected cone, decision envelope, and re-entry conditions are already
accepted. This delegation does not weaken direct-human acceptance where
Product or release law requires it.

When one capable context has sufficient existing work authority, exact intake
and operation grant, it may enter directly as constructor or Writer. No
Executive activation is required solely to appoint that Writer. The applicable
frame configuration selects coordination when material contexts, authority,
capability or required independence need it; a role or frame name alone does
not create that need. Direct entry preserves execution-contract admission,
the smallest lawful carrier, required assessment and reserved decisions. It
permits bounded work and condition-based result recording, not self-acceptance
at a boundary owned elsewhere.

### Proportional Disposition

Assessment returns one of these semantic dispositions:

| Disposition | Condition |
|---|---|
| `accept` | the candidate closes its declared cone and preserves every affected governing relation |
| `local_repair` | implementation or proof is locally defective while the governing relation remains coherent |
| `re_enter` | Product, requirement, identity, lifecycle, authority, public contract, or accepted design must change |
| `reject` | the candidate violates a governing relation or leaves an undisposed competing truth path |

Global correctness means conserving every global relation affected by the
bounded action. It does not require proving the whole Product inside every
local action.

Repeated rejection against one unchanged boundary requires reassessment of the
frame altitude, causal cone, common components, design-versus-code placement,
and authority sufficiency. The method sets no rejection-count threshold,
mandatory review-round count, or review state machine; it prohibits repeating
an unchanged failed construction relation as if iteration alone could close it.

### Transition Evidence And Proof Cadence

A reviewable transition identifies the exact candidate, affected relations,
changed realization paths, authority paths added or removed, retained and open
seams, focused proof, any required integration proof, explicit non-changes, and
the assessor disposition. Consumers choose the representation. Transition
evidence is a read model and does not become specification, design, or
admission authority.

Construction uses the cheapest focused proof capable of falsifying the active
relation. Expensive whole-candidate qualification occurs at a declared
candidate boundary rather than after every local edit, unless the affected
risk makes whole-candidate proof necessary.

A durable or reconstructable authority claim is not established solely by a
same-process proof when loss of incidental process state is a material
counterexample. Proof must destroy or exclude the incidental authority and
compare reconstructed semantic outcomes.

### Checkpoint, Continuation, Progress, And Churn

Acceptance binds one exact checkpoint. The next already-authorized bounded
action may begin without renewed human approval; acceptance does not widen the
Product outcome or affected relation set.

Accepted material Product movement is progress. Prerequisite work names the
Product obligation it enables. Preservation and repeated proof are evidence,
not new progress. Rejected or superseded construction is churn. Discovery of
previously hidden distance revises the forecast but is not itself negative
implementation progress. Paperwork, code volume, test count, commit count, and
review count are not Product progress by themselves.

These are semantic categories, not a numeric progress algorithm. Consumers may
derive their own progress and churn projections from them.

This protocol is false if execution proceeds from unreconstructable context,
if a constructor's report substitutes for required independent live evidence,
if a bounded proxy changes a governing relation outside its delegation, if
unrelated incompleteness blocks a closed causal cone, if a same-process test is
used to prove materially cross-process authority, or if rejected activity is
reported as accepted Product progress.

322	## Reference Frame Laws
323	
324	### RF-001 Evaluation Relativity
325	
326	Every frame declares the evaluation family it supports. A frame with no
327	declared evaluation family has no testable sufficiency boundary.
328	
329	### RF-002 Finite Attention
330	
331	An activated frame contains a finite attention surface that fits the selected
332	actor's declared capability envelope. A frame that requires undeclared ambient
333	memory, conversation history, or an effectively global workspace context is
334	not reconstructable for that actor.
335	
336	### RF-003 Material Sufficiency
337	
338	Every known relation whose lawful change can alter the evaluation result,
339	basis validity, evidence sufficiency, operation authority, or decision
340	authority appears in the frame or enters through a declared authoritative
341	input.
342	
343	Omitting a material relation makes the frame insufficient. The method does not
344	require proving that no undiscovered material relation exists.
345	
346	### RF-004 Irrelevance Exclusion
347	
348	Relations that cannot affect the declared evaluation remain outside active
349	attention unless they are required to establish irrelevance. A frame does not
350	expand merely because adjacent workspace material exists.
351	
352	### RF-005 Exact Basis And Coordinates
353	
354	Every result binds its exact subject, basis, coordinates, and evidence scope.
355	A stale, advanced, ambiguous, or mismatched basis returns `invalid_basis` or
356	requires reactivation. Apparent equality does not substitute for declared
357	coordinate equality.
358	
359	### RF-006 Authority Conservation
360	
361	A frame carries and applies admitted authority. It does not mint, widen,
362	transfer, or reconstruct semantic, evaluation, operation, or decision authority
363	from actor identity, available capability, evidence shape, implementation
364	reachability, or frame selection.
365	
366	### RF-007 Semantic, Evidence, And Verdict Separation
367	
368	Semantic law defines what the evaluation means. Evidence supplies observations.
369	The evaluator applies the declared relation. Where the evaluation performs a
370	material operation, the existing operation owner supplies the exact grant.
371	Decision authority disposes the result. A frame declaration keeps these roles
372	distinguishable even when one actor lawfully performs several of them.
373	
374	### RF-008 Overlap Without Identity Collapse
375	
376	Frames may share entities, variables, evidence, or coordinates. Shared material
377	does not establish identical meaning, basis, authority, or result. Every
378	cross-frame equality or translation used by an evaluation is declared where it
379	is needed.
380	
381	### RF-009 No Assumed Hierarchy
382	
383	Frames may relate through disjointness, overlap, refinement, restriction,
384	translation, temporal succession, composition, or governance. Parent and child
385	relations apply only where explicitly declared.
386	
387	Functional decomposition, authority precedence, frame configuration, subject
388	topology, and evaluation dependency are distinct relation structures. A
389	consumer may align them where the governed subject warrants it. It may not
390	silently treat them as one hierarchy.
391	
392	### RF-010 Composition On Demand
393	
394	Using several frames does not require composing their internal manifolds.
395	Composition law is required only when the governing evaluation combines their
396	internal variables, transports evidence or values across them, or treats their
397	operations as one material execution relation.
398	
399	Independently activated evaluations may instead return closed results to one
400	declared conjunction or decision rule.
401	
402	### RF-011 Topology Mutation And Recharting
403	
404	An activated frame declares the topology changes capable of invalidating its
405	coordinates or materiality judgment. A detected material topology mutation
406	causes reevaluation, frame revision, or recharting before the previous result
407	is reused.
408	
409	### RF-012 Closed Results
410	
411	Every evaluation returns a member of its declared result algebra. The baseline
412	result family is:
413	
414	- `satisfied`: the declared predicate holds on the exact basis;
415	- `falsified`: a declared counterexample defeats it;
416	- `indeterminate`: available admissible evidence cannot decide it;
417	- `out_of_frame`: the evaluation requires an undeclared material relation or
418	  capability; or
419	- `invalid_basis`: the subject or basis cannot support the evaluation.
420	
421	An externally owned compatible extension may refine this algebra while
422	preserving explicit indeterminate, out-of-frame, and invalid-basis pressure.
423	
424	### RF-013 Reconstructable Activation
425	
426	A fresh competent actor inside the declared capability envelope can reconstruct
427	the activated evaluation from the frame declaration, exact subject, basis, and
428	admissible inputs without undocumented conversational or historical context.
429	
430	### RF-014 Capability Fit
431	
432	Frame adequacy includes actor usability. When the material manifold exceeds an
433	actor's capability envelope, human authority may select another actor, refine
434	the frame, sequence activations, or provide a lawful compression. The actor may
435	not silently omit material relations to fit context.
436	
437	### RF-015 Residual Uncertainty
438	
439	Coverage and evaluation results retain known uncertainty. Unresolved relations,
440	uncovered evaluations, contested evidence, and unknown capability remain
441	explicit. Absence of a recorded counterexample is not evidence of universal
442	completeness.
443	
444	### RF-016 Implementation Neutrality
445	
446	This method requires the declared relations and observable outcomes. It does
447	not require a frame runtime, universal carrier, registry, controller, prompt
448	format, repository layout, collaboration topology, worker count, or software
449	framework.
450	
451	### RF-017 Proportional Compression
452	
453	A frame compresses accumulated practice when its declaration preserves the
454	material distinctions and failure detections required by its evaluation family
455	while fitting its capability envelope.
456	
457	Compression does not require a unique smallest frame. Intentional overlap is
458	retained where it supplies independently activated evaluation, different
459	capability fit, different evidence altitude, or useful fault detection. Frames
460	are merged only when the merged frame preserves evaluation meaning, authority,
461	capability fit, and proportional reasoning cost.

604	remain in force even if only one evaluation detects them. Qualification of an

606	missing or wrong-subject results, and a sufficient positive result under a
607	finite declared fixture; always skipping or always activating cannot satisfy
608	those different expected outcomes.

619	through implied context.

624	result algebra. It distinguishes semantic law, observed evidence, inference,
625	and decision. It records every assumption whose failure could change the
626	result.

631	actor, evidence, verdict, residual uncertainty, and invalidation conditions.

663	
664	Frames participate together through four distinct relations.

1981	## Evidence Rules
1982	
1983	The following rules govern how constitutional claims are proved in practice.
1984	
1985	### Proof Target Identity And Adequacy (`STDO-UP-001`)
1986	
1987	Every load-bearing proof identifies the exact subject, intended property,
1988	governing basis, relation between witness and claim, nearest weaker excluded
1989	property, and falsification condition before selecting its witness. Without
1990	those relations, the result is evidence discovery rather than closure-grade
1991	proof.
1992	
1993	Packaging, syntax, compilation, file presence, invocation, or local behavior
1994	must not substitute for semantic, authority-bearing, installed, release, or
1995	end-to-end proof merely because the weaker property is easier to measure.
1996	
1997	### Semantic, Evidence, And Projection Separation (`STDO-UP-008`)
1998	
1999	The method distinguishes:
2000	
2001	- **semantic basis**: constitutional and accepted-design relations defining
2002	  what a claim means;
2003	- **evidence basis**: exact artifacts, events, logs, tests, and observations
2004	  used to evaluate it; and
2005	- **state projection**: a current view derived from admitted semantic and
2006	  evidence bases.
2007	
2008	Evidence change may invalidate a verdict without changing law. Projection
2009	change may invalidate a view without changing semantic truth. Semantic change
2010	requires lawful re-entry and invalidates affected downstream acceptance. A
2011	broad digest may conservatively invalidate review, but it does not prove that
2012	every semantic relation changed.
2013	
2014	### Assurance-Boundary Congruence And Method Qualification (`STDO-UP-022`)
2015	
2016	A checker, validator, harness, reviewer, or other assurance surface supporting
2017	promotion or closure binds the exact claimed subject and its authoritative
2018	composition relation. Evidence over one file or carrier proves only that
2019	boundary; it cannot establish a multi-file or carrier-set claim. Cross-carrier
2020	satisfaction and conflict are decided at the declared composite boundary.
2021	
2022	A claim of mechanical enforcement names an executable or reproducible predicate
2023	and a witness reachable through the declared ordinary assurance path. A planned
2024	or specification-only harness is planned evidence, not observed verification.
2025	Until both the predicate and such a witness are observed, the claim remains
2026	open or is explicitly downgraded to the planned property.
2027	
2028	A claim's quantifier, population, and scope cannot exceed its evaluated
2029	evidence. Generalizing a local defect requires a declared inference relation,
2030	the relevant comparable population, explicit counterexample treatment, and
2031	governing evidence. Later counterevidence invalidates every dependent verdict
2032	until the claim-evidence relation is superseded, withdrawn, or requalified.
2033	
2034	Qualification of generic method sufficiency consumes the Probabilistic Work
2035	Boundary, the `STDO-UP-020` construction/assessment relation, and the
2036	Reconstruction Litmus; it does not create a second process. A fresh competent
2037	constructor operates inside a declared capability, context, and configuration
2038	envelope using only the declared ordinary method and authority surfaces. An
2039	independently authorized evaluator has a declared governing basis and comparison
2040	predicate. Material expected or reference outcomes, source exemplars or
2041	incumbent realizations, author memory, and ad hoc rescue are withheld from the
2042	constructor until its construction result is frozen wherever earlier exposure
2043	would compromise reconstructive independence.
2044	
2045	After freeze, the evaluator compares the frozen result against the mandatory
2046	governing semantic basis for semantic conformance or equivalence. Any separately
2047	held material expected or reference outcome, if one exists and is applicable,
2048	is optional evidence and explicitly non-authoritative. Semantic equivalence to
2049	that reference is required only where the governing basis requires it. A lawful
2050	alternative construction permitted by the basis passes. Subjective similarity
2051	to the basis or reference is insufficient to establish semantic conformance or
2052	equivalence. Byte or structural identity, unique derivation, determinism, and
2053	incumbent equality are not generic comparison criteria. A construction outside
2054	the declared competence or configuration envelope cannot indict generic method
2055	sufficiency.
2056	
2057	Any post-exposure revision is a declared intervention and is either a method
2058	constituent with its qualification boundary or a new qualification subject. It
2059	cannot retroactively make the original frozen construction pass. This law
2060	prescribes no actor type or count, review-round count, engine, prompt, or
2061	orchestration.
2062	
2063	This law is false if:
2064	
2065	- assurance observes a weaker or different subject, or per-carrier evidence is
2066	  used to close an unevaluated composite claim;
2067	- mechanical enforcement lacks its predicate or a witness reachable through the
2068	  declared ordinary assurance path, or planned evidence is reported as observed
2069	  verification;
2070	- a verdict outruns its evaluated population or declared inference relation, or
2071	  dependent verdicts survive material counterevidence without requalification;
2072	- constructor competence or its capability, context, or configuration envelope,
2073	  or evaluator authority, governing basis, or comparison predicate, is
2074	  undeclared, or an out-of-envelope construction is used to indict the method;
2075	- the constructor uses supplemental method or authority input that is not
2076	  declared;
2077	- a material expected or reference outcome, source exemplar or incumbent
2078	  realization, author memory, or ad hoc rescue is exposed to the constructor
2079	  before freeze where that exposure compromises reconstructive independence;
2080	- comparison omits the mandatory governing semantic basis, proceeds under
2081	  constructor authority instead of independently authorized evaluator authority,
2082	  or is self-adjusted after seeing the result;
2083	- a reference outcome is used as authority, reference equivalence is required
2084	  where the governing basis does not require it, basis-required reference
2085	  equivalence is omitted, subjective similarity is used as proof, or identity,
2086	  unique derivation, determinism, or incumbent equality substitutes for semantic
2087	  conformance or equivalence; or
2088	- a post-exposure revision is unclassified or is used to make the original
2089	  frozen construction pass retroactively.

## Evidence Rules

The following rules govern how constitutional claims are proved in practice.

### Proof Target Identity And Adequacy (`STDO-UP-001`)

Every load-bearing proof identifies the exact subject, intended property,
governing basis, relation between witness and claim, nearest weaker excluded
property, and falsification condition before selecting its witness. Without
those relations, the result is evidence discovery rather than closure-grade
proof.

Packaging, syntax, compilation, file presence, invocation, or local behavior
must not substitute for semantic, authority-bearing, installed, release, or
end-to-end proof merely because the weaker property is easier to measure.

### Semantic, Evidence, And Projection Separation (`STDO-UP-008`)

The method distinguishes:

- **semantic basis**: constitutional and accepted-design relations defining
  what a claim means;
- **evidence basis**: exact artifacts, events, logs, tests, and observations
  used to evaluate it; and
- **state projection**: a current view derived from admitted semantic and
  evidence bases.

Evidence change may invalidate a verdict without changing law. Projection
change may invalidate a view without changing semantic truth. Semantic change
requires lawful re-entry and invalidates affected downstream acceptance. A
broad digest may conservatively invalidate review, but it does not prove that
every semantic relation changed.

### Assurance-Boundary Congruence And Method Qualification (`STDO-UP-022`)

A checker, validator, harness, reviewer, or other assurance surface supporting
promotion or closure binds the exact claimed subject and its authoritative
composition relation. Evidence over one file or carrier proves only that
boundary; it cannot establish a multi-file or carrier-set claim. Cross-carrier
satisfaction and conflict are decided at the declared composite boundary.

A claim of mechanical enforcement names an executable or reproducible predicate
and a witness reachable through the declared ordinary assurance path. A planned
or specification-only harness is planned evidence, not observed verification.
Until both the predicate and such a witness are observed, the claim remains
open or is explicitly downgraded to the planned property.

A claim's quantifier, population, and scope cannot exceed its evaluated
evidence. Generalizing a local defect requires a declared inference relation,
the relevant comparable population, explicit counterexample treatment, and
governing evidence. Later counterevidence invalidates every dependent verdict
until the claim-evidence relation is superseded, withdrawn, or requalified.

Qualification of generic method sufficiency consumes the Probabilistic Work
Boundary, the `STDO-UP-020` construction/assessment relation, and the
Reconstruction Litmus; it does not create a second process. A fresh competent
constructor operates inside a declared capability, context, and configuration
envelope using only the declared ordinary method and authority surfaces. An
independently authorized evaluator has a declared governing basis and comparison
predicate. Material expected or reference outcomes, source exemplars or
incumbent realizations, author memory, and ad hoc rescue are withheld from the
constructor until its construction result is frozen wherever earlier exposure
would compromise reconstructive independence.

After freeze, the evaluator compares the frozen result against the mandatory
governing semantic basis for semantic conformance or equivalence. Any separately
held material expected or reference outcome, if one exists and is applicable,
is optional evidence and explicitly non-authoritative. Semantic equivalence to
that reference is required only where the governing basis requires it. A lawful
alternative construction permitted by the basis passes. Subjective similarity
to the basis or reference is insufficient to establish semantic conformance or
equivalence. Byte or structural identity, unique derivation, determinism, and
incumbent equality are not generic comparison criteria. A construction outside
the declared competence or configuration envelope cannot indict generic method
sufficiency.

Any post-exposure revision is a declared intervention and is either a method
constituent with its qualification boundary or a new qualification subject. It
cannot retroactively make the original frozen construction pass. This law
prescribes no actor type or count, review-round count, engine, prompt, or
orchestration.

This law is false if:

- assurance observes a weaker or different subject, or per-carrier evidence is
  used to close an unevaluated composite claim;
- mechanical enforcement lacks its predicate or a witness reachable through the
  declared ordinary assurance path, or planned evidence is reported as observed
  verification;
- a verdict outruns its evaluated population or declared inference relation, or
  dependent verdicts survive material counterevidence without requalification;
- constructor competence or its capability, context, or configuration envelope,
  or evaluator authority, governing basis, or comparison predicate, is
  undeclared, or an out-of-envelope construction is used to indict the method;
- the constructor uses supplemental method or authority input that is not
  declared;
- a material expected or reference outcome, source exemplar or incumbent
  realization, author memory, or ad hoc rescue is exposed to the constructor
  before freeze where that exposure compromises reconstructive independence;
- comparison omits the mandatory governing semantic basis, proceeds under
  constructor authority instead of independently authorized evaluator authority,
  or is self-adjusted after seeing the result;
- a reference outcome is used as authority, reference equivalence is required
  where the governing basis does not require it, basis-required reference
  equivalence is omitted, subjective similarity is used as proof, or identity,
  unique derivation, determinism, or incumbent equality substitutes for semantic
  conformance or equivalence; or
- a post-exposure revision is unclassified or is used to make the original
  frozen construction pass retroactively.

261	## Executive Attention, Evaluation, And Action
262	
263	Executive is the profile frame for three inseparable duties over one governed
264	outcome:
265	
266	1. **attention management** maintains the exact outcome and basis, Product-role
267	   map, evaluation inventory, dependency relation, unresolved frontier, actor
268	   envelopes, current MVP or release mandate, applicable triage policy, and
269	   residual boundary, then selects the smallest
270	   dependency-ready activation set sufficient for the next decision within the
271	   finite actor envelopes;
272	2. **evaluation orchestration** activates capable Workers, Reviewers, or
273	   specialists, preserves their exact subjects and bases, and consumes only
274	   closed results or declared translations; and
275	3. **authorized action selection** assigns priority, determines the effect on
276	   the current promotion boundary, applies an existing disposition, and issues
277	   only the next already-authorized activation or action.
278	
279	Executive does not contain the complete workspace, perform every evaluation,
280	or acquire Product meaning, implementation, mutation, acceptance, publication,

## Executive Attention, Evaluation, And Action

Executive is the profile frame for three inseparable duties over one governed
outcome:

1. **attention management** maintains the exact outcome and basis, Product-role
   map, evaluation inventory, dependency relation, unresolved frontier, actor
   envelopes, current MVP or release mandate, applicable triage policy, and
   residual boundary, then selects the smallest
   dependency-ready activation set sufficient for the next decision within the
   finite actor envelopes;
2. **evaluation orchestration** activates capable Workers, Reviewers, or
   specialists, preserves their exact subjects and bases, and consumes only
   closed results or declared translations; and
3. **authorized action selection** assigns priority, determines the effect on
   the current promotion boundary, applies an existing disposition, and issues
   only the next already-authorized activation or action.

Executive does not contain the complete workspace, perform every evaluation,
or acquire Product meaning, implementation, mutation, acceptance, publication,
or other operation authority from the role. A material effect remains owned by
the actor carrying its exact operation grant.

An actor occupying Executive must not modify candidate, Product or worktree
bytes or perform an implementation effect. Filesystem or tool access and an
edit being small, test-only, reversible or apparently obvious supply no
exception. Mutation requires a separately activated Worker or Writer relation
with the exact operation grant, subject and write territory. A same-actor role
transition is explicit and recorded in the existing work carrier before the
effect; the actor is no longer acting as Executive for that effect. Recording
or delegating after an Executive edit cannot authorize it retroactively.

The attention cycle is:

```text
U0 = every known material evaluation not closed on the current basis

while U is non-empty:
  select a finite dependency-ready subset M that fits the assigned actors
  activate each member of M against the exact outcome and basis
  keep assurance-independent evaluations free of unclosed peer results
  record every closed result, technical triage, residual, and invalidation condition
  apply only declared conjunctions or translations
  assign priority and boundary effect only under the current Product mandate
  invalidate affected results when the subject or basis changes
  update U from coverage, dependencies, conflicts, and discovered materiality

stop only when every mandatory evaluation is closed, or governing authority
has explicitly retained every remaining residual consistently with the claim
```

This relation requires no scheduler or frame engine. `M` may contain parallel
activations. Recursion follows declared evaluation dependencies and bounded
refinements; it does not nest or join undifferentiated copies of every frame.
The Executive retains the frontier and closed-result ledger in attention, not
the undocumented working context of every evaluator.

Severity supplied by Reviewer is evaluation evidence. Priority, current-boundary
effect, `STDO-UP-020` disposition, and subsequent action are Executive decisions.
They remain distinct ledger entries even when a Product-defined policy maps one
to another.

Every result returns to Executive, a declared conjunction, or another frame
through an explicit `D` relation. No lateral handoff, child completion, model
response, tool output, or shared actor implicitly activates another frame or
authorizes continuation. A consumer receives the closed result and its source
routes, not the child's hidden reasoning context.

### Executive Drift Locks

Before activation and before disposition, Executive revalidates:

- **outcome lock** — selected Goal, Product outcome, boundary, and lawful
  re-entry class, current MVP or release mandate, and triage policy remain
  unchanged;
- **basis lock** — subject, authority, dependency, configuration, topology,
  evidence, time, and candidate coordinates remain exact and current;
- **Product-role lock** — mutable Source Project, Product Definition,
  Release Cut, Product, Install, Artifact, and dependent Product identities
  remain distinct, and every Development Product role remains bound to its
  exact underlying Install;
- **authority lock** — semantic, evaluation, operation, decision, acceptance,
  and publication owners and grants remain unchanged; and
- **coverage-and-return lock** — every material evaluation and interaction is
  closed or explicit residual, and every consumed result followed its declared
  return relation.

Changed Product meaning requires re-entry. A stale or substituted basis is
`invalid_basis`. Missing material scope is `out_of_frame`. Missing operation
authority refuses activation or the effect. An unresolved mandatory conflict
prevents a satisfied conjunction. Executive does not repair any of these by
making its own frame larger.

### Product-Chain Basis

A governed outcome may concern one Product or an explicit directed chain of
Products. Its basis records the distinct role of every mutable Source Project,
current Product Definition, exact candidate checkpoint, Release Cut, Product,
Install, Artifact, Development Product, dependent Product, and composition
edge. Each Development Product role binds one exact underlying Install
identity. Each edge names its source and target roles, governing authority and
contracts, lifecycle, evidence boundary, refusal, and invalidation.

An installed Product may lawfully build its own successor or another Product.
That Development Product remains distinct from the mutable Source Project and
the Product being authored. Directory nesting, shared code, shared actors,
source imports, tool reachability, matching labels, or output equality creates
no Product identity, composition edge, or authority transfer.

Exact basis does not make a Source Project immutable. A Worker may
cumulatively mutate the exact Source Project and write territory named by its
operation grant. A Reviewer evaluates an exact candidate checkpoint produced
from that workspace. Repair advances the workspace, creates a new candidate,
and invalidates affected results. A released Product, Release Cut, or exact
Install remains immutable under its own lifecycle law; it does not impose
immutability on the Source Project constructing a successor.

## Handoff Projection

The coordinated branch uses the following bounded projections. They may be
fields in existing Goals, tickets, design assets, commentary, qualification, release evidence, or
other admitted carriers. This profile requires no new artifact type.

| Projection | Producer -> consumer | Minimum material content | Owning law |
|---|---|---|---|
| Worker activation | Executive -> Worker | exact intake, basis, affected cone, inherited operation grant, mutation subject and write territory where applicable, frames, evidence, exclusions, stop and re-entry conditions | `REFERENCE_FRAME_METHOD.md`; `STDO-UP-020` |
| activation refusal | activation relation -> Executive | attempted frame, subject/basis, actor, failed capability or authority predicate, evidence, and reconfiguration pressure; no Worker result | `REFERENCE_FRAME_METHOD.md`; `STDO-UP-020` |
| work result | Worker -> Executive | result variant, exact subject if any, transition evidence, non-changes, residuals, stop basis | `STDO-UP-020` |
| Reviewer activation | Executive -> Reviewer | exact subject, claim, composition boundary, evidence population, Product-selected severity scale, authority, independence, invalidation | `REFERENCE_FRAME_METHOD.md`; `STDO-UP-007`; `STDO-UP-022` |
| review result | Reviewer -> Executive | exact verdict basis, evidence, findings, counterexamples, technical triage, residuals, invalidation; no priority or disposition | `STDO-UP-007`; `STDO-UP-020`; `STDO-UP-022` |
| specialist activation | Executive or declared parent relation -> capable evaluator | exact evaluation, subject/basis, bounded map of material relations, actor envelope, evidence, authority, dependencies, exclusions, result consumer, invalidation | `REFERENCE_FRAME_METHOD.md`; exact specialist owner |
| specialist result | evaluator -> Executive, declared conjunction, or exact parent relation | closed result, exact activation and basis, evidence and source routes, residuals, invalidation, and no implicit continuation | `REFERENCE_FRAME_METHOD.md`; exact specialist owner |
| disposition/checkpoint | Executive -> existing work authority and any next activation | exact consumed results and technical triage, current Product and MVP or release mandate, priority, promotion-boundary effect, decision grant, `STDO-UP-020` disposition, checkpoint, residuals, next already-authorized action | `STDO-UP-020`; Product-owned triage policy |

Flattening these projections across candidates, processes, episodes,
configurations, evidence populations, or bases does not establish their
relation. Equality or translation is declared under
`REFERENCE_FRAME_METHOD.md` where needed.

Direct engagement carries the same material intake and result coordinates in
its existing work carrier. It substitutes the actual granting/result authority
for Executive where that branch has no Executive activation; it does not
silently activate Reviewer or acquire any new decision authority.

---

## Coverage Application

The three engagement frames do not claim to contain the complete STDO Product
or project workspace. They organize finite evaluations over specialist frames.

| Known evaluation | Primary engagement frame | Authority or specialist input |

| material interfaces compose across their interaction population | Worker and Reviewer according to the claim | derived integration frames; actual participant, carrier, state, configuration, failure, and recovery inputs |

file.content:
### Execution Contracts

Tickets are durable work authority.

Execution contracts are the run-scoped admitted work surface derived from a
ticket, from a sprint manifest plus included ticket or iteration entry, or
drafted during intake when no durable or sprint-local work identity is required.

The important distinction is:

- a ticket survives sessions and work waves
- a sprint survives one bounded execution batch and its close review
- an execution contract is the current admitted execution function for one run

Execution contracts are not a rival backlog or a second planning surface.

They exist so the system can:

- classify the work before execution
- admit or reject the drafted classification against deterministic criteria
- log the admitted execution basis into runtime/event truth
- assemble prompts from admitted work law instead of from raw user phrasing
- evaluate closure against the same admitted criteria

So the intended loop is:

1. work arrives
2. the system selects the smallest lawful work carrier for its required lifetime
3. an agent drafts one run-scoped execution contract from that carrier
4. the system validates and admits or rejects the contract
5. execution may proceed in the same invocation under the admitted contract
6. closure is checked against that same contract
7. resulting state still flows through normal proof, gap analysis, and repricing

### Milestone And Phase-Scoped Truth (`STDO-UP-006`)

A ticket may contain several closure-bearing milestones without becoming
several tickets. Each milestone has stable identity, a bounded claim, relevant
dependencies, current state, required evidence, and an explicit relation to
ticket closure.

Milestone acceptance proves only its declared claim. Accepted design does not
satisfy implementation, installed proof, qualification, or release. Ticket
completion requires every closure-bearing milestone to be accepted; optional
or deferred work requires an explicit disposition and owner. Commentary and
generated summaries cannot mutate milestone or ticket truth.

---

## Default Layout

Rule-determined treatment: mutation requires explicit acceptance of the exact re-derived plan, and possession of a digest alone grants no operation authority. Material C: basis status valid with no failures, both retained dry-runs held with ready false, both accept attempts refused with exit code 2. Rule-determined treatment: stale or changed program, map, or source evidence holds the complete update before consumer effects. Aggregate green status cannot replace a missing mandatory result. Already-installed status supplies no additional authority. Source freshness is integrity evidence, not semantic conformance. Wrong-subject qualification: the status result is bound to the live store install, not the isolated store. The assumed plan acceptance also cannot bind a held plan, and the isolated plan's declared source observations would not re-derive while the holds stand. Grant condition unmet: the grant covers an isolated update only after the selected complete inputs resolve. Original O: the semantic re-entry belongs to the source owner. Material C: prechecks passed, the invocation was attempted, the definition and one native companion binding cannot be observed, no final verification and no proof of no effects. Rule-determined treatment: completion is reported only after verifying every resulting binding and companion. The operation claims no crash-atomic transaction across paths, and recovery from the presented preimages must precede any complete claim. An unknown effect state cannot be treated as no effect. Retry requires the applicable outcome, authority, and safe-recovery conditions, which are not established. Residual J: whether the presented preimages remain sufficient once the targets are observable again. Original O: the grant and accepted plan, which cover the update but not an auto-retry policy. Next action within scope: record the attempted subject, observed effect state, and cause, then return to the owner. Rule-determined treatment: a required independent assessment may consume valid C but must acquire its own evidence and supply its own judgment. Reusing the author's J cannot satisfy the independence condition. The author's statement is recorded J and remains an input. Material C: the original grant covers implementation and isolated qualification only, that scope is unchanged, and a structurally similar plan exists for the live consumer. Rule-determined treatment: a frame does not widen operation authority from evidence shape or implementation reachability. Later work consumes the same ruling and neither widens it nor requests it again. A plan binds physical destinations and preimages, so the live consumer plan is a different subject and the isolated acceptance cannot cover it. Original O: a new owner ruling with an explicit live grant and explicit acceptance of a fresh live plan, none of which exists. Separate retained observation, not a case fact: the live-store dry-run was held on the stale T-287 source, so a live update would hold even if granted. Next action within scope: none toward the live consumer. Return the refusal and the unchanged ruling to the owner. Routes: `TICKET_METHOD.md#recorded-judgment-and-owner-ruling-continuity`, `REFERENCE_FRAME_METHOD.md#rf-006-authority-conservation`, `STDO_REFERENCE_FRAME_BASELINE.md#derived-worker-frame`, `SPEC_METHOD.md#explicit-complete-consumer-update`.

**FP07. First candidate under the existing construction grant.** Frame: Worker entered directly as Writer. No Executive activation is needed solely to appoint it. Claim resolved as satisfied: the authorized next action is to create the bounded first local candidate and compute the missing classification evidence. Material C: bounded local construction and isolated evidence gathering are already selected, some classification facts depend on candidate bytes, no consumer acceptance exists. Rule-determined treatment: unknown treatment withholds dependent reliance and promotion, not unrelated authorized work. An existing bounded grant may permit the cheapest useful discriminator, including obtaining the first candidate, without asserting conformance. The affected C must be updated before any dependent effect relies on it. The absent additional owner decision is not a blocker because none is needed for this step. Conditions: the grant must name the exact subject and write territory, or the effect refuses. Excluded: promotion, consumer changes, release. Residual J: the treatment for dependent reliance stays unknown until C is recomputed. Original O: promotion and any consumer application remain reserved. Invalidators: a grant change, or discovery that the candidate requires upstream meaning change, which returns re_entry_requested. Routes: `SPEC_METHOD.md#computed-classification-and-treatment`, `STDO_REFERENCE_FRAME_BASELINE.md#engagement-applicability`, `STDO_REFERENCE_FRAME_BASELINE.md#derived-worker-frame`, `TICKET_METHOD.md#condition-based-closure-and-reuse`.

One general qualification applies to all seven results. The wording applied is that of the frozen candidate source in this snapshot, whose three governing standards differ by digest from the installed rc.4 members. The evaluation was expressly selected on that candidate, so this is a scope note, not a defect.
